profile.headline: Member of Technical Staff at Forward Networks with a passion for functional programming
profile.summary: I enjoy writing clean code and helping others do the same, especially through the use of functional programming.  I believe the easiest way to write good code is to separate pure and impure code.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part-time position with startup developing tournament software that automatically creates pairings for each round and then communicates those pairings, as well as the result of each game, to the players via web and mobile apps.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work remotely on different teams to design, develop, test, and release a wide variety of client projects.

** Folding sheet metal based on a drawing
User draws the edge-on profile view of a folded piece of sheet metal.  Then the application translates the drawing into instructions and sends them to a metal-folding machine that creates the desired product.
- F#, C#, functional programming, Elmish.WPF, WPF, Windows, Azure DevOps, git

** EEG data sent to doctor from patient at home
EEG and video recorded of patient at home and then sent to their doctor.  EEG data is frequently sent while video clips containing events of medical interest are sent upon doctor request.
- C#, F#, functional programming, Language.Ext, UWP, Windows, Azure DevOps, git

** Email over High Frequency (HF) radio
Central administrator configures server-side device connected to the internet and an HF radio.  Each remote administrator configures a client-side device with embedded Wi-Fi and connected to an HF radio.  End-users connect via Wi-Fi and access their email via an email client of their choice.
- C#, functional programming, Language.Ext, Linux, Entity Framework, Azure DevOps, git

** Enterprise asset management system for US government
Government employees initially enter assets and later add results of system-guided assessments.  Asset management is aided by probabilistic budget forecasts and by reminders to do inspections and maintenance. 
- C#, object-oriented programming, WPF, Entity Framework, Azure DevOps, git

volunteerExperiences.description:
F# implementation for WPF of the influential Elm architecture.  This architecture, which is also known as the Model-View-Update (MVU) architecture, is one way to practice functional programming at the application level.
https://github.com/elmish/Elmish.WPF
